description: This file defines the FilterViewEvent class, which extends the Symfony Event class. It models a custom event for handling view filtering within the Goteo application, including properties for the view and associated variables, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: FilterViewEvent
classes.description: A custom event class extending Symfony's Event, used for filtering views in the Goteo application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a view and optional variables.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the current view associated with the event.

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Returns the variables associated with the view.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the view for the event.

methods.name: setVars
methods.description: Sets the variables for the view.
